title: Maximum-Entropy Exploration with Future State-Action Visitation Measures
abstract: arXiv:2603.18965v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Maximum entropy reinforcement learning motivates agents to explore states and actions to maximize the entropy of some distribution, typically by providing additional intrinsic rewards proportional to that entropy function. In this paper, we study intrinsic rewards proportional to the entropy of the discounted distribution of state-action features visited during future time steps. This approach is motivated by two results. First, we show that the expected sum of these intrinsic rewards is a lower bound on the entropy of the discounted distribution of state-action features visited in trajectories starting from the initial states, which we relate to an alternative maximum entropy objective. Second, we show that the distribution used in the intrinsic reward definition is the fixed point of a contraction operator and can therefore be estimated off-policy. translated_title: 基于未来状态-动作访问度量的最大熵探索
translated_abstract: 最大熵强化学习激励智能体探索状态和动作以最大化某个分布的熵，通常做法是提供与该熵函数成比例的额外内在奖励。在本文中，我们研究了与未来时间步中所访问的状态-动作特征的折扣分布熵成比例的内在奖励。该方法基于两个理论结果：首先，我们证明了这些内在奖励的期望总和是从初始状态出发的轨迹中所访问状态-动作特征折扣分布的熵的下界，我们将其与另一种最大熵目标联系起来；其次，我们证明了内在奖励定义中使用的分布是某个收缩算子的不动点，因此可以进行离策略估计。实验表明，新目标通常能够带来对特征更好的访问覆盖。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种与未来状态-动作特征折扣分布的熵成比例的内在奖励方法，理论上证明其期望总和是从初始状态出发的轨迹所访问分布熵的下界且可通过收缩算子的不动点性质进行离策略估计，从而实现了更优的最大熵探索。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes intrinsic rewards proportional to the entropy of the discounted distribution of future state-action features, proving that their expected sum lower-bounds the entropy of the discounted state-action distribution visited from initial states and that the distribution can be estimated off-policy as the fixed point of a contraction operator, leading to improved maximum-entropy exploration.
